request.prompt:
Goods: Nitrile examination gloves, powder free, medical
Country of origin: MY

Chosen so far: 40 Rubber and articles thereof

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 4015: Articles of apparel and clothing accessories (including gloves, mittens and mitts), for all purposes, of vulcanised rubber other than hard rubber
    contains 401512: Rubber; vulcanised (other than hard rubber), gloves, of a kind used for medical, surgical, dental or veterinary purposes
    contains 401519: Rubber; vulcanised (other than hard rubber), gloves, mittens and mitts other than surgical gloves
    contains 401590: Rubber; vulcanised (other than hard rubber), articles of apparel and clothing accessories (other than gloves, mittens and mitts)
- 4014: Hygienic or pharmaceutical articles (including teats), of vulcanised rubber other than hard rubber, with or without fittings of hard rubber
    contains 401490: Rubber; vulcanised (other than hard rubber), hygienic or pharmaceutical articles (excluding sheath contraceptives), with or without fittings of hard rubber
    contains 401410: Rubber; vulcanised (other than hard rubber), sheath contraceptives

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: Heading 4015 expressly covers gloves of vulcanised rubber, and subheading 401512 specifically covers gloves for medical use, such as nitrile examination gloves, whereas 4014 does not cover gloves.
